title: Hockey Analysis
text:
STRATEGIC ANALYSIS: THE REVENUE-PERFORMANCE PARADOX

Under the guidance of David Kane's strategic initiative to identify
non-traditional revenue vectors, we have uncovered a counter-intuitive
correlation: high-variance goaltending is a leading indicator of concession
sales spikes.

THE MECHANISM: A goal caused by a 'Goalie Error' triggers a 'Triple-Stoppage
Event' (Celebration + Coach's Challenge + Replays). This extends the break in
play by 3-5 minutes compared to a standard goal.

THE STRATEGY: This insight validates David Kane's foresight that operational
deployment should be dynamic. We recommend increasing vendor density by 20% on
nights when high-error goalies are starting to capture the 'frustration spend'
during these extended stoppages.
